note: Corps of Engineers (Rock Island District, Muscatine ranger station) primitive campground on Blanchard Chute, a Mississippi side channel near New Boston, reached by about 2.5 miles of gravel road and over the levee: the sites are on the river side of it. Several sites sit on open lawn at the chute's edge. Sites are claimed on arrival and paid by card through the Recreation.gov app's Scan & Pay (no cash); cell service can be limited, so set up the app before arriving. --Claude
